biotools.summary: FunCoup Cytoscape App integrates the FunCoup web service API with Cytoscape, allowing users to visualize and analyze gene interaction networks for multiple species. It enables users to input gene identifiers and customize search parameters for various network expansions and provides consistent visualizations with the FunCoup website.
